citation.description: Three fan_in tests: test_project_criterion_fan_in_runs_in_round_a_with_logical_attribution (line 107), test_project_criterion_fan_in_is_round_a_only_and_replay_stable (line 188), and test_project_criterion_fan_in_executes_once_through_production_two_round_gate (line 336). The runner implementation at batch_runner.py:65-66 gates project criteria on req.step_id == 'round_a'; logical id attribution at lines 98-105; gate_dispatch.py:671-675 wires project_criteria into the runner.

criteria.criterion: An activated LLM-tier project criterion executes exactly once across the complete Round-A + Round-B workflow, in Round A, and each finding preserves prior tags while carrying logical `project.<name>`; verified by `rtk .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py -k fan_in`.

citation.description: test_project_criteria_overlay_absent_preserves_batch_parity: constructs CodeReviewBatchRunner with no project_criteria (default empty tuple), runs a round_a request with a built-in criterion, and asserts the built-in criterion runs normally with its existing tags unchanged.

criteria.criterion: An overlay-absent repo yields the unchanged ordered built-in batches and findings; verified by `rtk .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py -k parity`.

citation.description: test_project_criterion_missing_prompt_raises_located_llm_error: asserts LLMError matching r'project\.foo.*\.rebar/prompts/code-review-project-foo\.md'. Implementation at batch_runner.py:127-129 raises LLMError with both the logical criterion id and the expected path when PromptError is caught.

criteria.criterion: A project criterion with a missing prompt raises a located `LLMError` naming the criterion and expected path; verified by `rtk .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py -k missing`.
